units.text: ⟦0⟧ comes with a rich set of options: some from POSIX and some being GNU extensions. Long option names are always a GNU extension, even for options that are from POSIX specifications. Options that are specified by POSIX, under their short names, are explicitly marked as such to facilitate POSIX-portable programming. A few option names are provided for compatibility with older or more exotic implementations.
units.sourceHTML: grep comes with a rich set of options: some from POSIX and some being GNU extensions. Options that are specified by POSIX, under their short names, are explicitly marked as such to facilitate POSIX-portable programming. A few option names are provided for compatibility with older or more exotic implementations.

units.text: Several additional options control which variant of the ⟦0⟧ matching engine is used. See ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧ Programs⟦3⟧.
